rows.ja: 産業・防衛・日本の提携先

relations.text: 主要な機能やクラウドサービスのホスティングをAWSとMicrosoft Azureに依存
relations.text_en: Depends on AWS and Microsoft Azure to host key platform features and cloud services

source.label: Palantir 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: We rely on the technology, infrastructure, and software applications, including software-as-a-service offerings, of certain third parties, such as AWS and Microsoft Azure, in order to host or operate some or all of certain key technology platform features or functions of our business

relations.text: Foundry・Gotham・Apollo・AIPを、Azureの政府向け機密環境で提供する提携
relations.text_en: Partnership to deploy Palantir Foundry, Gotham, Apollo and AIP in Azure Government Secret and Top Secret clouds

source.label: Microsoft Source の発表
source.quote: Palantir will deploy their suite of products – Foundry, Gotham, Apollo, and AIP – in Microsoft Azure Government and in the Azure Government Secret (DoD Impact Level 6) and Top Secret clouds.
source.note: 提供は認可が前提です。

relations.text: Oracleが、OCI上で動くPalantirを戦略パートナーとして記載
relations.text_en: Oracle lists Palantir as a strategic partner running on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure

source.label: Oracle 戦略的パートナーのページ
source.quote: Oracle and Palantir revolutionize data-driven operations, combining AI with sovereignty and lower costs.

relations.text: NVIDIAの計算基盤とNemotronモデルを組み合わせた運用向けAI基盤を共同構築
relations.text_en: Building an integrated operational AI stack combining NVIDIA computing and Nemotron models

source.label: NVIDIA ニュースルーム の発表
source.quote: Palantir is integrating NVIDIA accelerated computing, NVIDIA CUDA-X libraries and open-source NVIDIA Nemotron models into its Ontology framework at the core of the Palantir AI Platform.

relations.text: Snowflake AI Data CloudとPalantir Foundry・AIPを統合する提携
relations.text_en: Partnership integrating Snowflake AI Data Cloud with Palantir Foundry and AIP

source.label: Snowflake の発表
source.quote: today announced a new partnership that integrates Snowflake's AI Data Cloud with Palantir Foundry and Palantir Artificial Intelligence Platform (AIP)

relations.text: PalantirがNebiusを推奨するソブリンAI基盤パートナーに指定
relations.text_en: Palantir named Nebius its preferred sovereign AI infrastructure partner

source.label: Nebius 6-K(の発表)
source.quote: Palantir names Nebius its preferred sovereign AI infrastructure partner, bringing Nebius compute and inference inside the Palantir perimeter

relations.text: SAP Business Data CloudとPalantirのOntology・AIPをつなぐ提携
relations.text_en: Partnership connecting SAP Business Data Cloud with Palantir Ontology and AIP

source.label: SAP 6-K(2025年第2四半期)
source.quote: SAP and Palantir announced a partnership to facilitate joint customers' cloud migration journey and modernization programs

relations.text: Accenture Palantir Business Groupを設立。AccentureはPalantirの優先グローバルパートナー
relations.text_en: Formed the Accenture Palantir Business Group; Accenture is a Palantir preferred global partner

source.label: Accenture ニュースルーム の発表
source.quote: have formed the Accenture Palantir Business Group designed to accelerate the delivery of advanced AI and data solutions

relations.text: 防衛・宇宙・安全保障部門が、Palantirの AIを各プログラムで活用する提携
relations.text_en: Boeing Defense, Space & Security partners with Palantir to use its AI across programs

source.label: Boeing の発表
source.quote: Boeing Defense, Space & Security to leverage Palantir capabilities across programs for global military customers

relations.text: L3Harrisが年次報告で、新しい能力開発の戦略的提携先としてPalantirを挙げている
relations.text_en: L3Harris’ annual report names Palantir among its strategic partnerships for developing new capabilities

source.label: L3Harris 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: We also collaborate with innovative partners, such as our strategic partnerships with Palantir Technologies, Shield Capital, Anduril and Amazon Kuiper

relations.text: Palantir Technologies JapanがFujitsuと、FoundryとAIPを組み込む戦略的な世界提携を締結
relations.text_en: Palantir Technologies Japan entered a strategic global partnership with Fujitsu incorporating Foundry and AIP

source.label: Palantir 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: we, through Palantir Technologies Japan KK, entered into a strategic global partnership with Fujitsu Limited through which the parties will incorporate the capabilities of Foundry and AIP

relations.text: 日本でSOMPOホールディングスとの共同管理会社を設立し、その後支配権を取得
relations.text_en: Created a jointly controlled entity in Japan with SOMPO Holdings and later obtained a controlling interest

source.label: Palantir 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: in November 2019, we created a jointly controlled entity in Japan with SOMPO Holdings, Inc., in which we subsequently obtained a controlling interest in November 2022

relations.text: Cleveland-Cliffsが、運用システムの刷新でPalantirと複数年の戦略的提携を発表
relations.text_en: Cleveland-Cliffs announced a multi-year strategic partnership with Palantir to modernize operational systems

source.label: Cleveland-Cliffs 10-Q(2026年第2四半期)
source.quote: we announced a multi-year strategic partnership with Palantir Technologies, a prominent enterprise software company

relations.text: Veritoneが年次報告で、AIソリューションの競合としてPalantirを挙げている
relations.text_en: Veritone’s annual report names Palantir among competitors in AI-enabled solutions

source.label: Veritone 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: we face competition from various sources, including large, well-capitalized technology companies such as Google, Microsoft, Amazon, Axon and Palantir

relations.text: Palantir FoundryがGoogle CloudとそのMarketplaceで利用可能に。複数年の提携
relations.text_en: Palantir Foundry is available on Google Cloud and its Marketplace under a multi-year partnership

source.label: Google Cloud ブログ
source.quote: Palantir Technologies is making Foundry , its fully managed SaaS platform, available on Google Cloud and Google Cloud Marketplace
source.note: 2022年の発表で、現在の状況は再確認していません。
source.note_en: Announced in 2022; the current status has not been re-verified.

relations.text: Lumenが決算資料で、Connected Ecosystemの提携先の1社としてPalantirを挙げている
relations.text_en: Lumen cites Palantir among partners in its Connected Ecosystem

source.label: Lumen 決算資料(2025年第3四半期)
source.quote: Connected Ecosystem off to a great start with partners like Palantir, Digital Realty, QTS, and Commvault

relations.text: HD Hyundaiが、造船所のデジタル化(Future of Shipyardプロジェクト)でPalantirとの協力を強化
relations.text_en: HD Hyundai said it is strengthening cooperation with Palantir to digitally transform its shipyards (Future of Shipyard project)

source.label: HD Hyundai の発表
source.quote: HD Hyundai is strengthening its cooperation with global leaders, including Palantir, a software company that enables AI-driven decision making, and Siemens, a global industrial solutions provider.
source.note: グループ全体の発表で、上場しているどのHD Hyundai法人かは明記されていません。
source.note_en: A group-level announcement; the listed HD Hyundai entity is not specified.

relations.text: HD Hyundaiが2024年4月にPalantirと無人水上艇の開発で提携し、共同開発のTENEBRISを公開
relations.text_en: HD Hyundai partnered with Palantir in April 2024 to develop unmanned surface vessels and unveiled the co-developed TENEBRIS USV

source.label: HD Hyundai の発表
source.quote: After partnering with Palantir, a top-tier company in the defense AI sector, in April to develop unmanned surface vessels (USVs), HD Hyundai unveiled 'TENEBRIS,' co-developed with Palantir, for the first time at the AI Expo for National Competitiveness in the U.S. this May.
source.note: 2024年の発表で、やや古い情報です。

relations.text: PalantirとLearが、LearのFoundry・Warp Speed・AIP利用を全世界の製造拠点に広げる5年間の提携拡大を発表
relations.text_en: Palantir and Lear announced a five-year expansion of their partnership, broadening Lear’s use of Foundry, Warp Speed and AIP across its global manufacturing footprint

source.label: Lear の発表(joint with Palantir)
source.quote: Palantir Technologies Inc. (NASDAQ: PLTR), a leading provider of AI software, today announced a five-year expansion of its partnership with Lear Corporation (NYSE: LEA), a global automotive leader in Seating and E-Systems.

relations.text: CognizantがPalantirと戦略的提携。医療事業TriZettoでFoundryとAIPを使い、企業のAI変革を進める
relations.text_en: Cognizant announced a strategic partnership with Palantir to use Foundry and AIP in its TriZetto healthcare business and pursue enterprise AI transformation for clients

source.label: Cognizant の発表
source.quote: Cognizant (NASDAQ: CTSH) announced a strategic partnership with Palantir Technologies Inc. (NASDAQ: PLTR) to accelerate AI-driven modernization across healthcare and enterprise operations.

relations.text: Voyagerが上場申請書類(S-1/A)で、Starlab合弁の海外の出資パートナーであり重要なパートナー・顧客としてPalantirを挙げている
relations.text_en: Voyager’s IPO registration statement (S-1/A) lists Palantir as an international equity partner in the Starlab JV and a key partner and customer

source.label: Voyager Technologies S-1/A
source.quote: We intend to operate Starlab through Starlab JV, a Voyager-led and majority-owned global joint venture, with international equity partners that include Airbus, Mitsubishi, MDA Space and Palantir.
source.note: 上場前の提出書類です。

relations.text: Archerが決算発表で、次世代の航空技術向けAIを作るPalantirとの基盤的な提携があると説明
relations.text_en: Archer’s Q1 2025 results release states it has a foundational partnership with Palantir to build AI for next-gen aviation technologies

source.label: Archer Aviation 8-K Ex.99.1(2025年第1四半期決算)
source.quote: Archer has forged a foundational partnership with Palantir to build artificial intelligence for the future of next-gen aviation technologies.

relations.text: Centrusが決算発表で、ウラン濃縮の拡張にPalantirのAI基盤を適用し、約3億ドルのコスト削減の可能性を特定したと報告
relations.text_en: Centrus reported it partnered with Palantir to apply its AI platform to the uranium enrichment expansion, identifying about $300M in potential cost savings

source.label: Centrus Energy 8-K Ex.99.1(2026年第1四半期決算)
source.quote: Partnered with Palantir to leverage its artificial intelligence platform; early work identified ~$300 million in potential costs savings and additional improvements expected to reduce manufacturing lead times and accelerate expansion’s timetable
source.note: 削減額は同社が特定した「可能性」の数字です。
source.note_en: The savings are potential figures identified by the company.

companies.name: Mercury Systems
companies.sub: 防衛エレクトロニクス

relations.text: MercuryとPalantirが、米軍向けプログラムの資材計画と工場運営を自動化する戦略的契約を発表
relations.text_en: Mercury and Palantir announced a strategic agreement to automate material planning and factory operations for U.S. military programs

source.label: Mercury Systems の発表
source.quote: Mercury Systems, Inc. (NASDAQ: MRCY, www.mrcy.com ), and Palantir (NASDAQ: PLTR, www.palantir.com), a leading provider of AI software bringing commercial approaches to aerospace and defense, today announced a strategic agreement to enhance the automation of material planning and factory operations to accelerate the delivery of processing technologies for U.S. military programs.

relations.text: Red Catが、VNavのBlack Widowドローンへの統合とWarp Speed製造OSの導入でPalantirと戦略的提携
relations.text_en: Red Cat announced a strategic partnership with Palantir to integrate VNav into Black Widow drones and deploy the Warp Speed manufacturing OS

source.label: Red Cat の発表
source.quote: Red Cat Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: RCAT) (“Red Cat” or the “Company”), today announced a strategic partnership with Palantir Technologies Inc. (Nasdaq: PLTR) to integrate Visual Navigation software (VNav) into Red Cat’s Black Widow drones and to deploy Warp Speed, Palantir’s manufacturing OS.
source.note: 2024年12月の発表で、やや古い情報です。

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
